hints: Find the coefficient of $x^3$ in the expansion of $(3+2ax)^5$: $\binom{5}{3} 3^2 (2a)^3 = 10 \times 9 \times 8a^3 = 720a^3$.
Find the coefficient of $x^2$ in the expansion of $(2+ax)^6$: $\binom{6}{2} 2^4 a^2 = 15 \times 16 \times a^2 = 240a^2$.
Set up the equation $720a^3 = 6(240a^2) = 1440a^2$ and solve for $a$.
walkthrough:
Determine the $x^3$ term in the binomial expansion of $(3 + 2ax)^5$:
$$\binom{5}{3} 3^{5-3} (2ax)^3 = 10 \cdot 3^2 \cdot 8a^3 x^3 = 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8a^3 x^3 = 720a^3 x^3$$
$$\text{Coefficient of } x^3 = 720a^3$$

Determine the $x^2$ term in the binomial expansion of $(2 + ax)^6$:
$$\binom{6}{2} 2^{6-2} (ax)^2 = 15 \cdot 2^4 \cdot a^2 x^2 = 15 \cdot 16 \cdot a^2 x^2 = 240a^2 x^2$$
$$\text{Coefficient of } x^2 = 240a^2$$

Set the first coefficient equal to $6$ times the second coefficient:
$$720a^3 = 6(240a^2) \implies 720a^3 = 1440a^2$$
